stories.headline: Vietnam: Nha Trang's streets turn to waterways as more heavy rain is forecast
stories.ticker: Up to around **260 mm** of rain forecast in 24 hours on Khanh Hoa coast /// Dan Tri: **Nha Trang** streets flooded, travel disrupted across Khanh Hoa /// Lao Dong: roads in **Nha Trang** and **Ninh Hoa** flooded, landslides reported /// Past 28 days about **410 mm**, **194%** of normal, against 210 mm expected /// Gusts of about **42 km/h** forecast, flooding the main risk
stories.voice_script: Vietnam: on the coast north-east of Nha Trang, up to around 260 mm of rain is forecast in the 24 hours from this morning. Local outlet Dan Tri reports that prolonged heavy rain has flooded several streets in Nha Trang, disrupting travel and raising safety concerns across Khanh Hoa Province. Lao Dong newspaper says overnight downpours left roads in Nha Trang and Ninh Hoa locally flooded, with landslides reported on the early morning of 28 November. The ground is already sodden. About 410 mm has fallen over the past four weeks here, roughly 194% of what is normal for the period. Winds are not the main worry, with gusts of about 42 km/h forecast. The danger is the water, running off hillsides into already swollen streets and rivers.

stories.headline: Greece: Aegean gusts near 110 km/h forecast as the storm spell drags on
stories.ticker: Gusts could reach about **110 km/h** in the northern Aegean /// **Volos** port lies about **90 km** from the strongest winds /// About **44 mm** of rain forecast over 24 hours /// News 24/7: heavy rain expected across Greece, worst on **Sunday 29 November** /// Among the highest gusts for the season since **1940** here
stories.voice_script: Greece: out in the northern Aegean, gusts could reach around 110 km/h, enough to make life difficult for ferries and small boats. Volos, the port on the mainland coast, lies about 90 km from the sea area where the strongest winds are forecast. Rain accompanies the wind, with about 44 mm forecast over the day. That is a fair share of what this area normally gets in a month. News 24/7 reports that thunderstorms, strong winds and snow are sweeping Greece, and a meteorologist there warns of particularly heavy rainfall on Sunday, 29 November. Gusts this strong are among the highest for this time of year since 1940 at this spot, where 65 km/h is already a strong blow.

stories.headline: Japan: a wet autumn near Nagano gets another 80 mm on saturated hillsides
stories.ticker: About **80 mm** of rain forecast in 24 hours north of Nagano /// **490 mm** in 28 days, **226%** of normal, **15 of 28** days wet /// Japan News: **Level 4** landslide warning in southern Niigata Prefecture /// Saturated slopes raise landslide risk on mountain roads /// Gusts about **60 km/h**, temperatures **0.7 °C** to **12 °C**
stories.voice_script: Japan: north of Nagano, in the mountains of central Honshu, about 80 mm of rain is forecast over the next 24 hours. It has been a very wet month. Around 490 mm has fallen in four weeks, about 226% of normal, with 15 of the last 28 days heavy. The Japan News reported on 22 November that a Level 4 landslide warning was issued in southern Niigata Prefecture because of heavy rain and snow. With soil already saturated, even a moderate downpour can loosen slopes, so rivers and mountain roads are the places to watch. Gusts of about 60 km/h are forecast, and temperatures should range from near 1 °C overnight to about 12 °C in the afternoon.

stories.headline: New Mexico, USA: gusts near 110 km/h forecast over the Sangre de Cristo foothills
stories.ticker: Gusts could reach about **110 km/h** north-west of Las Vegas, NM /// Among the highest gusts for the season since **1940** here /// Gusts over **65 km/h** on **10 of 28** days /// Highs near **2 °C**, lows around **-6.2 °C** with strong wind /// Le Monde: over **900,000** homes without power after major US storm
stories.voice_script: New Mexico, USA: north-west of Las Vegas, in the high country, gusts could reach around 110 km/h, strong enough to bring down trees and power lines. For this time of year, that is among the highest gusts since 1940 at this location, where 75 km/h counts as a notably windy day. It is not a one-off. Gusts have topped 65 km/h on 10 of the last 28 days, so people here are used to a battering. Temperatures are forecast to stay low, from about minus 6.2 °C overnight to a high near 2 °C, which will make the wind feel harsher. Elsewhere, Le Monde reported a major storm left more than 900,000 homes without power across central and eastern states for Thanksgiving.

stories.headline: Iceland: ferries and roads disrupted as gusts near 130 km/h are forecast offshore
stories.ticker: Gusts could reach about **130 km/h**, steady wind near **72 km/h** /// Iceland Review: gales, **10-metre** waves, ferry sailing cancelled /// Pressure about **980 hPa**, low **165 km** to the west /// About **12 mm** rain forecast, temperatures **4.7** to **8.9 °C** /// Gusts over **65 km/h** on **14 of 28** days
stories.voice_script: Iceland: out at sea south-east of the coast, gusts could reach about 130 km/h, with steady winds near 72 km/h. Iceland Review reports gales, 10-metre waves and landslide risk disrupting travel, including a cancelled Herjólfur ferry sailing. Pressure is low, about 980 hPa here, with a centre of low pressure about 165 km to the west driving the storm. Rain is part of the picture, with about 12 mm forecast over 24 hours, and temperatures between roughly 5 and 9 °C. Gusts have topped 65 km/h on 14 of the last 28 days, so Icelanders have had little respite from this run of Atlantic weather.
